cohort: 330 infants with NOWS born at gestational age ≥35 weeks and did not require NICU transfer
finding: Infants with NOWS managed by the eat, sleep, console approach lose significantly more weight than nonopioid exposed infants and are at increased risk of morbidity and health care use.
mod_finding: Median percent weight loss was significantly greater compared to early weight loss nomograms for both vaginally-delivered infants at 48 hours and cesarean-delivered infants at 48 hours and 72 hours.
